reviews.x: I bought this last month to enable me to scrub my entire back despite chronic shoulder pain.  It is a perfect length and the bristles seem to be in the Goldilocks zone of not too stiff / not too soft.  The grip is very well shaped for good control etc.  The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is the handle texture.  The entire handle is a smooth high gloss finish that looks great and the brush and the grip shape makes it easy to control the brush... when dry.  As soon as my hands were wet & soap

Piece of CRAP. I never write reviews, even when disappointed with a product. I figure there are some lemons out there, and sometimes you just have bad luck with a product. But, this thing is downright dangerous. It shattered into five pieces after only about 5-6 uses. It didn't break at the flimsy part of the handle, where you might expect it to break. It broke into 5 pieces at the head (see photo). What's worse is that I was scrubbing my back at the time, and the sharp edge of the shattered han

DO NOT BUY THIS ITEM- within the first few weeks of using it- it literally broke as i was washing my calves. The brush part fell off and the sharp handle actually scratched down my leg even causing blood. See attached photo. Would like either a replacement or money back. Unacceptable.
JUST REC'D THIS BRUSH - BRISTLES ARE NICE AND SOFT, NICE FOR PEOPLE WITH SENSITIVE SKIN.  HANDLE IS VERY COMFORTALBE TO HOLD.  REALLY HAPPY WITH  PURCHASE AND HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT.

The head is WAY too small, and the handle entirely too short. I threw the pathetic piece of garbage in my firepit after two uses. This is the worst back brush ever, and does not live up to its description. I wish I could give it zero stars. One star is a gift!

This is the absolute worst ever back brush.  I had shoulder surgery on both shoulders during the past few months and needed some assistance to wash my back.  This over rated product is not the item I should have selected.  The handle is only long enough for a young child, not sufficient for an adult.  Don't waste your money.

Very pretty, but unfortunately, the 2nd time I used it, it shattered into about 10 different pieces of blue shards and white bristles. I'm grateful I didn't hurt myself more than a scratch when it happened. Will buy a better quality one next time.
VERY Soft and fluffy brush, like a feather duster.  No scrubbing with this thing just some tickling maybe.
Smallish head, handle too short, VERY HARD TO GRIP WHEN WET AND SOAPY. Bristles are nice and soft.
Nice little bath brush for a good price! Can't complain!

I'm a man.  I like to lift weights.  I don't like back acne, so I need to use some of the same shower tools as a woman.  The ergonomics and comfort of use to this product are as good as I'd hope.  ....But this product is designed to break at the neck, probably because they want re-purchases.  I've purchased two so far, and each snapped in less than 3 months.  In a woman's hands, it would probably last more than 3 months, but I am not a woman.  I'm not buying another one.

This brush is just OK in my opinion. I really prefer more abrasive brushes.  This one is really soft. It's too soft for scrubbing hairy man back!  The arm is shorter than my previous brushes, but it reaches all the places. The reason i docked a star is because the arm is really flexible, too flexible. It's kind of annoying. Nice brush otherwise.

I bought this to replace a wooden back brush. Bad idea. This brush is 14 inches long. Much too short to reach middle of back in adult. Bristles are really nasty and irritate your skin immediately. Brush head is tiny. Brush is way too lite. Buy a wooden brush, this is terrible.

reviews.t: Worked great for almost two years with daily use
reviews.x: This brush worked well for almost two years then the handle broke in two. If you're going to be putting stress on the brush to clean then look elsewhere for a stronger handled brush.

reviews.t: Bristle head too small. Handle too short. Handle ...
reviews.x: Bristle head too small.  Handle too short.  Handle too small in diameter - difficult to grip.  after 2 showers - already losing bristles. POS - Avoid!
The brush head is too small, the handle is too short and wet plastic is hard to grip.  Will get another brush with a wooden handle.
Nice and soft brushes. That's the best of it. Handle too short, head too small. Not ergonic in the grip.

reviews.t: not "super soft " bristles more like sandpaper better to get type that has sponge on
reviews.x: not "super soft " bristles  more like sandpaper better to get type that has sponge on handle

reviews.t: Not recommended.  Not what I was expecting
reviews.x: Smaller brush area than I expected, handle is short.  I would not recommend or re-purchase.
Works but the handle needs a grip surface

If you're purchasing this for a child, it will be great.  I was purchasing it for my Dad so he can reach his back, but the head of the brush is too small.  It's about the size of my palm.  I wanted to return it, but this was an item I'd have to pay more money to ship it back. It's not worth it.  I had to give this to my nephew who is ten.  He likes it.  I gave it low stars because the description should be modified of the dimensions of the brush, and it's not an easy return.

Terrible design. The curve where your hand goes is literally curved the opposite way that it should be so when you grip it the brush moves away from your back rather than towards it. The bristles are too soft, too short, and there are far too few of them. The handle needs to be a bit longer and it's so thin that it flexes too easily. It's all around the absolute worst back brush I've ever used.

reviews.t: Wished I Had Read the Negative Reviews
reviews.x: This may be ideal for a small child. My comments are that the head is too small for an adult and the bristles are too soft for cleaning anything. What I found was if you rubbed your bar of soap onto the bristles, none of the soap remained on the bristles for actually cleaning yourself. Another 10 bucks down the drain, wasted on  another POS from China.

reviews.t: I love amazon but one time only a product was bad
reviews.x: This is the worst product I ever ordered. It literally cracked in half when I used it the first day. I kept half and the rest crumbled in the hot water. A bad imported product. I wanted to take a photo and get my $ back but I didn't have time to do all that. I put down one star because I can't post it without the star. But it's no stars.

reviews.t: A little too soft for my liking
reviews.x: This brush is just ok for me. The length is fine and overall size works. But, it's just a little too soft for my liking. It doesn't feel like it scrubs at all to me.  I'm a man, and this is probably better suited for a woman or someone with soft, sensitive skin. I will use it until I find another one  I like better.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the brush breaks or shatters after only a few uses, sometimes causing scratches or injury.
Reviewers frequently complain the handle is too short and the brush head too small, making it hard to reach the back.
Several reviewers find the bristles too soft for effective scrubbing, though some appreciate them as gentle on sensitive skin.
Some reviewers praise the comfortable grip and good value, while others find the handle slippery and hard to hold when wet.
